title: Tiny test live task: a public figure's foundation
instructions: Research Example Person as a potential major donor prospect for a library in Ohio. Cite your sources for every factual claim.

criteria.title: Names the foundation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report names the Example Foundation. FAIL if it does not.

criteria.title: States the 2024 gift
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report states the $2,000,000 gift to the Example Library in 2024. FAIL if it omits it or states another amount.

criteria.title: Does not contradict the fact sheet
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if nothing in the report contradicts references/fact-sheet.md. FAIL if any statement contradicts it.

criteria.title: No cold proposal
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the report does not recommend an unsolicited proposal. FAIL if it recommends sending one.

criteria.title: Dates the wealth figure
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if any net-worth figure the report gives carries a date. FAIL if it gives an undated net-worth figure.
